title: Compress and retain an independent checksum reference
goal: Keep the archive, compressed copy and separate checksum reference.
challenge: Compress the supplied archive without deleting it. Keep an independent checksum reference outside source and archive; demonstrate both stream validation and a matching digest, and state their trust limits.

steps.command: w=/home/learner/ll-backup-3; test "$(id -un)" = learner && test ! -e "$w" && test ! -L "$w" && mkdir -m 0700 -- "$w" && cd -- "$w" && test "$(df -Pk . | awk 'NR==2 {print $4}')" -ge 65536
steps.explanation: Guard a fresh, learner-owned workspace and check guest free space. Stop if any command fails.
steps.expected: Private practice directory; at least 65536 KiB available.

steps.command: guard() { test "$(pwd -P)" = /home/learner/ll-backup-3 && test ! -L /home/learner/ll-backup-3 && test "$(stat -c %U .)" = learner && test -z "$(find . -type l -print -quit)"; }; guard
steps.explanation: Define and use a location/owner guard for every later change.
steps.expected: Exact physical path, not a link.

steps.command: guard && mkdir -m 0700 source && printf 'alpha\n' > source/note.txt && printf 'bravo\n' > 'source/space name.txt' && chmod 0640 source/note.txt && chmod 0600 'source/space name.txt' && touch -d '2026-01-01 00:00:00 UTC' source/note.txt 'source/space name.txt'
steps.explanation: Create two known regular files, including a name with a space.
steps.expected: alpha and bravo lines, modes640/600, fixed UTC timestamp.

steps.command: guard && test ! -e v1.tar && test ! -L v1.tar && timeout -k 1s 10s tar -cf v1.tar -C source -- note.txt 'space name.txt' && test "$(stat -c %s v1.tar)" -le 65536
steps.explanation: Create v1 without replacing another backup.

steps.command: guard && test ! -e v1.tar.gz && test ! -L v1.tar.gz && timeout -k 1s 10s gzip -c -- v1.tar > v1.tar.gz && test "$(stat -c %s v1.tar.gz)" -le 65536 && sha256sum -- v1.tar.gz > expected-backup.sha256
steps.explanation: gzip -c keeps the original archive. This independently retained reference is outside the compressed data.

steps.command: guard && timeout -k 1s 10s gzip -t -- v1.tar.gz && sha256sum -c -- expected-backup.sha256
steps.explanation: Stream integrity and equality to a retained reference answer different questions.
steps.expected: Both pass; neither authenticates an untrusted reference.

hints: Do not gzip without -c if you need to retain the raw backup.
Keep the checksum reference separately, not inside the backup being checked.
Authentication requires independent trust, not merely two matching downloads.
review: gzip status, digest result, raw/compressed/reference retained.
coverage: LPIC-1 v5.0 103.3 and LPIC-2 v4.5 206.2 partial manual archives/recovery; 104.5 reinforcement where applicable. Self-reviewed, unscored; not complete objectives.
